display.purpose: One per page, page-level hero heading, Petrona.

label.purpose: Nav links, bed-count labels, footer headings — uppercase, 600 weight.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Minimal lift, e.g. focus ring corner.

shadows.name: btn-primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Ambient clay-tinted glow under the primary CTA; stronger offset on forest sections.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single clay-filled call-to-action per view (e.g. Check Availability → Booking.com).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; background: #b2593a; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(178, 89, 58, 0.55); transition: background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8e4229; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b2593a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action, transparent with current-color border; inverts automatically on dark forest sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #2f4538; background: transparent; color: #2f4538; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(47, 69, 56, 0.08); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b2593a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Link Button
components.description: Inline 'View details →' style link used inside room rows and content blocks; never a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #2f4538; padding: 0; border: none; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #637569; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #b2593a; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky forest-green header bar with logotype, nav links, phone link, and mobile hamburger.
components.html:
Tuckerbox Motor InnSouth Gundagai · NSW
HomeRooms
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; background: #2f4538; color: #faf6ee; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-nav__logo { font-family: Petrona, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.375rem; color: #faf6ee; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__logo small { display: block; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(250,246,238,0.75); } .ds-nav__link { color: #faf6ee; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding-block: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav__link:hover, .ds-nav__link[aria-current="page"] { border-color: #b2593a; }

components.name: Placeholder Photo
components.description: Signature stand-in for pending real photography: hairline-grid texture with a camera-tagged caption; must be swapped for approved client photography before production-final.
components.css: .ds-photo-placeholder { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background-color: #e7d9c3; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(47,69,56,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(47,69,56,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-photo-placeholder__tag { position: absolute; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0.75rem; background: rgba(43,42,39,0.78); color: #faf6ee; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Editorial Room Row
components.description: Alternating photo/detail layout for room listings — replaces a uniform card grid.
components.html:
Deluxe Queen Room

1 large double bed

Kitchenette, air conditioning, tea/coffee maker, walk-in shower.
components.css: .ds-room-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 3rem; align-items: center; padding-block: 4rem; } .ds-room-row__media { border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; background: #e7d9c3; aspect-ratio: 4/3; } .ds-room-row__beds { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2f4538; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Grouped Facility Row
components.description: Themed, annotated definition-list row used in the facilities page — replaces an icon-tile grid.
components.html:
Free private parking
On site, no booking required.
components.css: .ds-facility-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(43,42,39,0.12); } .ds-facility-row dt { font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.25rem; color: #2b2a27; } .ds-facility-row dd { margin: 0; color: #5c5a54; font-size: 0.875rem; }

narrative.overview:
Tuckerbox Motor Inn's site is a practical, honest roadside stop rendered in editorial type and warm earth tones — not a resort fantasy, not a generic hotel-template default. It refuses the dense rate-search hero widget, the uniform icon-tile amenity grid, and the gold-and-script spa aesthetic in favor of a confident dark forest-green header/footer, a single clay accent reserved for one call-to-action per view, and full-bleed photography standing in for decoration. Imagery throughout the shipped build is a clearly labelled hairline-grid placeholder (camera icon + "Photo pending" tag) — a deliberate "pending real photography" marker, not a finished visual texture, and it must be swapped for real property photography before the site is treated as production-final.

As shipped, typography is Petrona (display serif, editorial and warm) paired with Public Sans (body/UI sans) — a substitution the build made from the direction contract's original Fraunces/Inter pairing specifically to avoid the overused "AI-default" font set, while keeping the same editorial-serif-plus-clean-sans character the brief called for. Room listings use an alternating editorial photo/detail row (.room-row), never a uniform card grid; facilities use a grouped, annotated two-column list (.facility-group/.facility-row), never an icon-tile grid.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory ground, sandstone banding between sections — never stark white.
Forest green as a committed dark field for header, footer, and primary navigation context (not a thin accent).
Clay reserved for exactly one job per view: the primary CTA and small active-state marks.
Editorial alternating rows and grouped annotated lists in place of generic card/tile grids.
Every image is a labelled dev placeholder, not finished art.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Clay fills exactly one element per view — the page's single primary call-to-action (or an active-state mark) — never a secondary button, a background tint, or decoration.

rules.name: The Never-Stark-White Rule
rules.body: Page and panel backgrounds are ivory or sandstone; pure white (#ffffff) is reserved for small surfaces sitting on top of those grounds (tag chips, facility notes), never the page canvas itself.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No standalone label/eyebrow sits above a heading anywhere in the shipped build; headings carry their own weight via size and the serif face, not a kicker device.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft and diffuse (blurred, low-opacity) for lift; a hard, solid-offset shadow (neobrutalist style) does not belong in this system.

dos: Do reserve clay (#b2593a) for exactly one primary action or active-state mark per view.
Do keep all booking/contact actions pointed at the real external channels — Booking.com share link, tel:0269440300, mailto:enquiries@tuckerbox.com.au — never a new form backend.
Do use the .photo-placeholder hairline-grid + "Photo pending" tag for any image slot until real, approved property photography replaces it.
Do keep room listings as alternating editorial rows and facilities as grouped annotated lists; both were deliberate choices against the generic card/tile default.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (durations collapse to 0ms; .reveal renders fully visible with no transition).
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading — none exists in the shipped build, and it is not part of this system.
Don't introduce hard-offset (neobrutalist-style) shadows; all elevation in this system is soft and ambient.
Don't replace the inline line-art SVG icon set with a glyph icon font or emoji.
Don't fabricate guest-review quotes, ratings, or prices — the build intentionally links out to Google/Tripadvisor/Booking.com instead.
Don't treat placeholder photography as final decoration; it is a defect-marker pending real assets, not a texture choice to keep.
